name: Good Standing: The Helix Edition
description: A cheerful lifestyle-format show produced entirely by HelixCorp's internal media arm, following four 'real' HelixCorp employees as they navigate housing upgrades, aug-subsidy approvals, and community contribution milestones. Every episode ends with a compliance score reveal and a warm group meal in a HelixCorp canteen. The cast rotates annually; former cast members are contractually prohibited from discussing their time on the show.
cultural_impact: The show's segment format — 'The Good Week, The Better Choice, The Best You' — was quietly adopted as the structure for HelixCorp's mandatory employee wellness check-ins, blurring the line between entertainment and behavioral monitoring.
story_hooks: A former cast member, now living off-grid, wants to sell their story but needs protection from HelixCorp's content compliance team.
Someone has obtained the real, unaltered compliance data for every cast member across six seasons — it's a map of who HelixCorp has been quietly disappearing.
A crew is hired to infiltrate a taping and swap a corporate-approved script page with one containing a live on-air disclosure of the debt enrollment practice.
